Fixed both issues:

1. **`src/slug.js`** — the regex collapsed non-alphanumeric runs into hyphens but never trimmed leading/trailing ones, so `'  Hello, World!  '` produced `'-hello-world-'` instead of `'hello-world'`. Added `.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')`.

2. **`package.json`** — the `test` script (`node --test test/`) was independently broken on this Node build (v22.19.0/win32): passing an explicit directory path makes the test runner try to `require()` the directory itself as a single test file rather than recursing into it, failing with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` regardless of `slug.js` content. Node's no-arg default discovery (`node --test`) finds `test/slug.test.js` correctly, so I changed the script to `"node --test"`. No test file was touched.
